title: Thunderbird for Android will not operate on my Pixel 7 phone.
creator: mdyekman
content: I have downloaded the Thunderbird for Android app per the instructions for using a QR code. It seems to export and import properly, but nothing appears in the folders. I think this may be an issue with not entering a pin or password for the email accounts. I cannot find anything on any of the help sites that tells me how to open my email account on my phone and enter the password. I also downloaded and exported/imported Thunderbird for android to my Samsung tablet and it works fine. I did have to install it several times, but finally it worked. This is very frustrating. Thank you for any assistance you can provide.

title: How to "view unread messages" in Thunderbird for Android?
creator: ajt1047
content:
I'd expect there to be some way of "only showing unread messages" (just like there is in the Desktop version of Thunderbird), but it doesn't seem to be there?

"Mark as read" is there but a bit well-hidden (swipe left either on an individual message or on a thread) but "View only unread" seems to be missing?

This is the case with both a personal Gmail account and a self-hosted IMAP account. In case it's relevant in the first case there is a "[Gmail]/Starred" subfolder but no "[Gmail]/Unread" one; in the second case the only subfolders are ones I have created myself.
